plainText:
Hirofumi Nojima (Japanese: 野島裕史 Nojima Hirofumi) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Nojima was born as Yūji Nojima on April 16, 1973, in the of , . His father and younger brother Kenji are also voice actors. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was affiliated with the talent management firm . Nojima occasionally lent his voice to the , and his two best-known roles in that work were Gym Leaders Volkner and Grant of Sinnoh and Kalos, respectively. In addition, he provided the voices for and in Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon.
